envelope.description: Add SecurityFinding interface, isSecurityFinding type guard, risk-family verdict representation, and policy-override staleness check

body.title: Add SecurityFinding interface, isSecurityFinding type guard, risk-family verdict representation, and policy-override staleness check
body.summary: Add `SecurityFinding` as a plain TS interface extending the base `Finding` (src/workflow/review-round/finding.ts) with kind:'security', checkId, violatedPolicyRef, evidence, fixability, confidence, enforcementMode, the revision-anchored override fields overriddenBy/overrideReason/overriddenAt, and receiptId (an optional string id of a corroborating VerificationReceipt -- never the receipt object itself). Add an `isSecurityFinding` type guard checking the `kind` discriminant. Add a risk-family verdict representation modeled as an informational, zero-severity SecurityFinding for applicable/not-applicable/uncertain families. Add the policy-override staleness check comparing overriddenAt against the Scope's current revision.
acceptanceChecks: SecurityFinding structurally extends base Finding -- every Finding field present plus the security-only fields including receiptId
isSecurityFinding returns true only for an object whose kind discriminant is exactly 'security'
A risk-family verdict (applicable/not-applicable/uncertain + reason), including not-applicable ones, is representable as an informational, zero-severity SecurityFinding
A stale override (overriddenAt diverges from the Scope's current revision) is rejected by the staleness check
The framework's shared reconciliation pass accepts a mixed Finding/SecurityFinding list with zero change to its own logic
The docgen 'review-report' renderer renders a round containing SecurityFinding entries with zero change to its own type signature

tests.name: SecurityFinding structural extension of base Finding (all base fields present + security-only fields)
overriddenAt vs current Scope revision comparison (stale override rejected)
risk-family verdict recorded as informational zero-severity SecurityFinding for not-applicable/uncertain families
reconciliation pass consuming a mixed Finding/SecurityFinding list
docgen review-report render of a round containing SecurityFinding entries
